تطأمنت (form IIq)
# تَطَأْمَنْتُ (taṭaʔmantu) /ta.tˤaʔ.man.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَطَأْمَنَ (taṭaʔmana)
# تَطَأْمَنْتَ (taṭaʔmanta) /ta.tˤaʔ.man.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَطَأْمَنَ (taṭaʔmana)
# تَطَأْمَنْتِ (taṭaʔmanti) /ta.tˤaʔ.man.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَطَأْمَنَ (taṭaʔmana)
# تَطَأْمَنَتْ (taṭaʔmanat) /ta.tˤaʔ.ma.nat
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
